description: Converts an input voltage to eight bits and puts each bit out as a gate

params.text: Shifts the converted range to -5V to 5V in place of 0-10V

inputs.text: The voltage that is converted, 0-10V spanning the eight bit range, or -5V to 5V when BiPolar is on; voltages outside the range are clamped
With a cable patched here the voltage is converted on each rising edge and the bits are held between edges; with nothing patched the conversion runs continuously

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that bit of the converted value is set and 0V while it is clear
Carries all eight bits of the converted value at once, one channel per bit, 10V for a set bit and 0V for a clear one
